caption: The drawing depicts a single vintage corset rendered in shades of beige and light brown. The corset features thick shoulder straps, ribbon ties at the shoulders and bottom front, and a series of vertical seams and panels that create a structured form. The left cup and the central panels include detailed texturing, with parallel ribs and diagonal lines indicating boning or reinforced stitching, while the right side shows a smoother fabric surface with a diamond pattern stitched into the fabric. Down the right side of the corset, there is a vertical row of six gold or brass-colored buttons, with neatly stitched buttonholes beside them. The edges, seams, and folds are carefully outlined and shaded, providing a sense of depth and realism. The background is plain and lightly shaded, keeping the focus entirely on the corset. The artist’s signature, "Frank McEntee," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Corset
